---
description: "Use when writing or changing Python in the sales demo."
applyTo: "ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter/**/*.py"
---

- Keep functions small and use type hints on new code.
- Add pytest tests for behavior changes and preserve existing tests.
- Use the starter's virtual environment locally and standard-library application code.
- Follow `ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter/README.md` and the current lab's scope.
- Run Python and pytest from `ws-part1-github-copilot/labs/starter`.
